ya5.1.2:3.1: Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ , na dukkhaṃ. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ dukkhañceva dukkhasaccañca. (Ka)
ya5.1.2:5.1: Samudayasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso samudayo, na samudayasaccaṃ. Samudayasaccaṃ samudayo ceva samudayasaccañca. (Kha)
ya5.1.2:8.1: Nirodhasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso nirodho, na nirodhasaccaṃ. Nirodhasaccaṃ nirodho ceva nirodhasaccañca. (Kha)
ya5.1.2:11.1: Maggasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso maggo, na maggasaccaṃ. Maggasaccaṃ maggo ceva maggasaccañca. (Kha)
ya5.1.2:14.1: Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na dukkhaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ. Dukkhañca dukkhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca dukkhasaccaṃ. (Kha)
ya5.1.2:18.1: Samudayasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na samudayasaccaṃ, samudayo. Samudayañca samudayasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva samudayo na ca samudayasaccaṃ. (Ka)
ya5.1.2:21.1: Nirodhasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodho. Nirodhañca nirodhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva nirodho na ca nirodhasaccaṃ. (Ka)
ya5.1.2:24.1: Maggasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na maggasaccaṃ, maggo. Maggañca maggasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva maggo na ca maggasaccaṃ.
